matches.text: # pi-action's default is 30 minutes; use most of the job's 45, leaving time to save the thread.

- `workspace.viewImage` works on pi-durable hosts such as pi-action, with the limits it has on Pi, and the image reaches the model (#365). The new `images` option of `createPitDurableExtension` takes an `ImageProcessor`, such as `createNodePhotonImages()` from `@earendil-works/pi-durable/images/node`, to resize and convert images to the model's limits; without one, PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP images within the byte limit attach as they are. See [Images](docs/durable.md#images).

- On pi-durable hosts, Pit stops offering pi-durable's coding tools (`read`, `write`, `edit`, `bash`, `powershell`) to the model by default, so the model sees `typescript` as on Pi, and `tools.*` no longer binds the file and shell tools that `workspace.*` and `shell.*` supersede. This changes what the model is offered on existing pi-action workflows. `allowedTools` in the user's and a trusted project's `pit.json` now applies there and keeps matching tools offered, and the new `hideTools` option of `createPitDurableExtension` replaces the hide list or turns hiding off with `false`. See [Tools the model sees](docs/durable.md#tools-the-model-sees).

- `pit/durable` exports Pit's `typescript` tool for hosts built on `@earendil-works/pi-durable`, such as pi-action. `createPitDurableExtension({ cwd, agentDir, trustProject, ui, log })`, also exported as `createPiDurableExtension` and listed under `pi.durable` in `package.json`, returns an extension with the tool and prompt sections for its guidelines and the user and project function catalogs. Session functions are conversation entries, so a reopened Harness and forks keep them; nested `tools.*` calls go through the host's `executeTool()` and reach every other callable tool, including pi-durable's coding tools, and questions (`ui.*` and the confirmations `functions.*` asks for) work on asynchronous hosts: Pit answers them from a `ui.answer` entry in the conversation or posts them through the host's `ui.ask` and ends the turn, so nothing waits for a person. Interactive hosts can still pass blocking dialogs, during which the program deadline pauses. Project trust is off by default, project function promotion and removal ask through the host's dialogs (and fail without them), and `session.*`, `commands.*`, `models.set`, model requests, and `workspace.viewImage` report that they are unavailable. The entry loads without Pi's coding agent, Pi's TUI, or TypeBox, and `@earendil-works/pi-durable` is an optional peer dependency. See [Pit on pi-durable hosts](docs/durable.md).

On [pi-durable hosts](durable.md#tools-the-model-sees) such as pi-action, `allowedTools` applies the same way to the tools Pit hides there, pi-durable's coding tools by default. Pit reads it when the host creates the extension; the project's file needs the host's `trustProject` and `cwd` options.

Pit is a Pi extension, but its `typescript` tool also runs on hosts built on [`@earendil-works/pi-durable`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@earendil-works/pi-durable), such as [pi-action](https://github.com/cv/pi-action), which keeps one durable conversation per GitHub issue or pull request. The `pit/durable` entry point exports a pi-durable extension: the tool, its usage guidelines, and the user and project function catalogs as prompt sections.

The `pit/durable` entry point exports a pi-durable extension: the tool, its usage guidelines, and the user and project function catalogs as prompt sections.

2. If the conversation has an unused answer with that key, the call returns it. An answer is an entry of kind `ui.answer` with data `{ key, kind, answer, by?, url? }`: `answer` is a boolean for confirm and a string for select and input. pi-action writes it as the user message that delivers the answer. An answer of the wrong type is skipped.

- **Treat prompts as code.** Whoever can write to the conversation, for example by commenting on an issue that pi-action answers, can ask the model to run commands. Limit who can drive the conversation, and keep secrets the job does not need out of the host's environment.
| [pi-durable hosts](durable.md)        | Run Pit's tool on a pi-durable host such as pi-action, and know what differs from Pi              |

Hosts built on [pi-durable](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@earendil-works/pi-durable), such as [pi-action](https://github.com/cv/pi-action), can load the same `typescript` tool from `pit/durable`: `createPitDurableExtension()` returns a pi-durable extension, and session functions persist as conversation entries. Slash commands stay Pi-only; [Pit on pi-durable hosts](docs/durable.md) lists what works and the security differences.
